q: How many prescribers are in the data?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk

q: How many nurse practitioners are there in Indiana?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Nurse Practitioner' AND state = 'IN'

q: What is the average opioid share for Family Practice prescribers?
gold: SELECT avg(opioid_share) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Family Practice'

q: Which state has the most Pain Management prescribers?
gold: SELECT state FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Pain Management' GROUP BY state ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
original_gold: SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Pain Management' GROUP BY state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
revision_note: reference returned an extra count column the question did not ask for

q: List the NPIs of the 5 highest-risk prescribers in Ohio.
gold: SELECT npi FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'OH' ORDER BY rank_logreg LIMIT 5

q: How many prescribers are excluded but still prescribing?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE excluded_but_prescribing

q: What is the total Part D drug cost for prescribers in Vermont?
gold: SELECT sum(drug_cost) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'VT'

q: Which 3 specialties have the highest average cost per beneficiary? Only include specialties with at least 1000 prescribers.
gold: SELECT specialty FROM mart.provider_risk GROUP BY specialty HAVING count(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY avg(cost_per_beneficiary) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

q: How many prescribers have an opioid share above 50%?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE opioid_share > 0.5

q: What is the median opioid share for Internal Medicine nationally?
gold: SELECT median FROM mart.peer_stats WHERE specialty = 'Internal Medicine' AND state = '*' AND feature = 'opioid_share'

q: How many dentists in California wrote more than 1000 claims?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Dentist' AND state = 'CA' AND claims > 1000

q: Which city in Texas has the most prescribers?
gold: SELECT city FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'TX' GROUP BY city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
original_gold: SELECT city, count(*) AS n FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'TX' GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
revision_note: reference returned an extra count column the question did not ask for

q: What is the highest outlier score among psychiatrists?
gold: SELECT max(score) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Psychiatry'

q: How many prescribers are in the top 100 by risk and also in the top 1000 by outlier rank?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE rank_logreg <= 100 AND rank <= 1000

q: Average number of beneficiaries per prescriber in New York
gold: SELECT avg(beneficiaries) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'NY'

q: How many distinct specialties are there?
gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT specialty) FROM mart.provider_risk

q: What share of General Practice prescribers have any long-acting opioid claims?
gold: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN long_acting_opioid_share > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'General Practice'
original_gold: SELECT avg(CASE WHEN long_acting_opioid_share > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'General Practice' AND long_acting_opioid_share IS NOT NULL
revision_note: reference silently excluded prescribers without opioid claims; question asks about all of them

q: Which 5 states have the highest average brand-name share?
gold: SELECT state FROM mart.provider_risk GROUP BY state ORDER BY avg(brand_share) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

q: How many physician assistants have a days-per-claim above 60?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Physician Assistant' AND days_per_claim > 60

q: What is the total number of Part D claims across all cardiologists?
gold: SELECT sum(claims) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE specialty = 'Cardiology'

q: Number of prescribers in Indiana whose risk rank is in the top 10,000
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'IN' AND rank_logreg <= 10000

q: What is the average outlier score of prescribers flagged for cost per beneficiary?
gold: SELECT avg(score) FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE 'cost_per_beneficiary' = ANY(reasons)

q: How many peer groups (specialty and state) have more than 500 Family Practice prescribers for opioid share?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM mart.peer_stats WHERE specialty = 'Family Practice' AND state <> '*' AND feature = 'opioid_share' AND n > 500

q: Which specialty has the most prescribers in Montana?
gold: SELECT specialty FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'MT' GROUP BY specialty ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
original_gold: SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM mart.provider_risk WHERE state = 'MT' GROUP BY specialty ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
revision_note: reference returned an extra count column the question did not ask for
